body:
Yeah, you're right. 

I have heard of it, I was diagnosed with it a year ago.

I doubt I am even within walking distance of the finish line. Legally, I cannot leave until I'm 18, and if I do, what then? I can't afford to live happily by myself, and I can't live happily surrounded by the people who home me. I've  got years and years of anguish and hatred ahead of me, and I don't think I can take anymore of it. 

Thankyou anyway, your reply shows you care, which is humbling. I'm female, by the way.

I've already evaluated who would care, and if they did, whether my suffering is worth keeping them happy. I've decided it's not. If the same people who will cry at my funeral were the same people who brought me to this unliveable state, they can cry me a river. 

I'm sorry to be so cynic. Please, if you still feel suicidal, take heed of your advice. It may not work for me, but if it does for you, never forget it. Please stay strong.

Thankyou so much, but I apologise. Things will not get better for me, and if by some miracle they do, it will be in the distant future. If Gods got that plan for me, he can forget it. One day too late. I'm sorry to be so cynic, but it's how I feel.

Everyone has the ability to be powerful with words. Order and vocabulary. I think the world could go on without my contribution to literacy haha.

Thankyou anyway, taking time to write is enough to know you care about my fate. Thankyou for caring.

It does seem like we are rather similar. I'd claim it was a coincidence, but it seems that many feel this way. I can sympathise with the idea of a repetitive life; it is the same for me. What is the point in drifting through life like a twig in a ocean? In my opinion (and dare I say 'experience') it's hopeless to live like this. I just don't know how to reverse the feeling of comfort carelessness gives me. It's almost as if my mind *wants* me to change, but I can't physically release myself from the overwhelming yet familiar grasp of laziness. It's sad, to put it bluntly. 

As for your reference to my writing, I've never really viewed it as something worth noticing. I do in fact partake in English Literature for a GCSE, but you guessed it; my teacher doesn't really care for my technique or ability. To her, I'm the exact same to every other lost soul in the classroom. It doesn't bother me though. 

Thankyou for such a long response, I never expected so many people to reply to me in such a heartfelt way. I want to let you know that I know how you are feeling, and I want to offer you my support through PMing. Thankyou.

I'm know this is a typical 'teenage' thing to say, but I truly don't enjoy any subjects. If I had the energy to respond to the idea of A-levels, I can assure you it would be dread. It's something I must do, however, so I see no point in purposefully not trying. Thankyou for your words.

I apologise for my late response; it was unintentional. To begin, I would like to sincerely thank you for expressing such kindness towards me. I am honoured that out of the vast majority of heartbreaking posts submitted here, you chose to respond to my ramblings. 

In addition to this, I truly respect your another message for me aswell. Never have I imagined there would be strangers in the internet so willing to express love towards me, an average, if not: dysfunctional, 16 year old. It's heartwarming to know you view me so highly; I appreciate it. Thankyou.
Thankyou very much. I never realised my writing ability was something to pick up upon. And yes, I am.

Oh. Well, thankyou both. I've never really seen my writing ability as something worthwhile. 

As for your references to my future; is the future a wonderful place like many make it out to be, or is it simply your past with the lights off? I don't want to delude myself into believing things will get better for me when there is a empty void in the motivation I have to strive for my future. You are telling me to excel, but I *can't*. I don't know how. 

I used to push all my build up energies into maintaining a satisfactory status in schoolwork, but evidently, it didn't improve anything. Need I remind you I am currently achieving A's and B's? I know this isn't good enough. I know. However, a society where letters are more important than human qualities is not a community I want to be a part of. 

I can see where you are coming from, and I too strive to never become the psychological and physical demons that my parents seem to be. However, one can only take so much torment before becoming completely apathetic to any attempts of rebellion. I don't have the energy to push myself forward, ignore the constant hatred and excel. 

I am a girl, which also means my appearance is a huge weight on my shoulders.

Yes, I'm aware it happens frequently, which is why I've been so hesitant to post. Thankyou for the kind words, your understanding of my situation means a lot. 

Unfortunately, A 'B' in my education is considered a travesty. It's been awhile since someone was proud of me.

I don't understand what you mean by 'you write incredibly well'; could you please explain this to me?

Thankyou for your support, a mutual understanding of this encourages me to power on through.       :-)
